paragraphs: A Land Rover N63 engine rebuild starts from £6,500, regardless of which of the two models it's fitted to — the Range Rover or Range Rover Sport. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most N63 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six N63-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover N63 engine?
faqLeft.a: The N63 is BMW's 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 petrol engine, used in Land Rover applications from 2022. It's a BMW-sourced engine, not a JLR-designed unit.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the N63?
faqLeft.a: Range Rover (L460) P530 and Range Rover Sport (L461) P530.

faqLeft.q: Does the N63 differ between Land Rover models?
faqLeft.a: Different applications vary by tuning. Both applications are petrol MHEV with a 48V mild-hybrid system.

faqLeft.q: Is an N63 from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. Registration/VIN matching is required — different applications vary by tuning.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover N63 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on N63 rebuilds across both Land Rover models it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you work on N63 MHEV applications?
faqLeft.a: Yes. All Land Rover N63 applications are mild-hybrid, and the relevant 48V system components are accounted for during a rebuild.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an N63 from a Range Rover P530?
faqRight.a: Yes. The N63 in the Range Rover is one of the applications we work on.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an N63 from a Range Rover Sport P530?
faqRight.a: Yes. The N63 in the Range Rover Sport is one of the applications we work on.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover N63 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an N63 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most N63 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
